'''Intra-Corellian Intelligence''' was an intelligence center located in the [[Governmental Sector|Government District]] of [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].<ref name="Location" /> It was the site of the controls for the [[Ion Wall]].<ref name="Government Clearance">{{TORcite|type=faction|[[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]|Government Clearance|[[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]}}</ref>
